title: Partner integration solo scratch
content:
2026-03-12 — sprint scratchpad (solo)
Owner: Sofia Martinez — partner ops/marketplace
Quick goal: unblock Sandbox deployment for GreenKey partner so they can start alpha tests next week. Focus: auth, sample payloads, and latency gating.

Top priorities (today):
- [ ] Confirm service-account scope for GreenKey staging (token exchange) — check with infra before EOD
- [ ] Finalize sample payload schema for embeddings + metadata (need field list from GreenKey)
- [ ] Run end-to-end sandbox flow and capture logs (turn on DEBUG for 10m)
- [ ] Add temporary route in gateway: /partners/greenkey/v1/test -> routes to staging cluster

Meeting notes from 03/12 standup with GK (quick bullets):
- GK product needs: batch embed API + streaming text+metadata (non-blocking streaming ok)
- They will send sample dataset (500 docs) by Friday 03/13
- Security: require mTLS for production; OK to use token for sandbox
- SLA expectation: 200ms median for single-doc embeddings at 1rps in staging

Immediate blockers:
- Missing service-account role: currently cannot mint service token for GK staging. Ticket opened: infra -> MP-472 (linked).
- Schema mismatch: their metadata has `source_url` and `ingest_ts` as strings; we want ISO8601 for timestamps. Need to confirm if they can switch or we normalize on our side.

Integration checklist (quick, rough):
- Auth
  - [ ] Sandbox token flow documented + sample curl
  - [ ] Rotateable API key created (expire in 90d)
  - [ ] mTLS setup plan for prod (ops lead: Liam C)
- API/Schema
  - [ ] Final schema v0.1 agreed on (fields: id, text, source_url, ingest_ts, tags)
  - [ ] Sample responses for embedding and json-lines examples
- Staging & Testing
  - [ ] Route created on gateway (staging namespace)
  - [ ] Deploy small canary with 1 replica + CPU limit 2 cores
  - [ ] Synthetic load test (50 qps sustained for 5m) -> capture p95/p99
- Observability/Alerts
  - [ ] Tracing enabled for partner requests (x-partner-id header)
  - [ ] SLO alarm if median > 300ms for embeddings
  - [ ] Cost tag on logs: partner=greenkey
- Docs & Onboarding
  - [ ] One-pager for GK engineer onboarding (include curl examples)
  - [ ] Slack channel created: #partners-greenkey (temp)

Notes on testing plan:
- Do quick locally-run script: tools/partner-test/greenkey-run.sh (use staging creds) -> collects latency CSVs
- If p95 > 700ms under small load, revert to smaller batch size or force single-token streaming behavior

Prompts/questions to follow up with GK:
- Can you confirm ingest_ts format? (ISO8601 preferred)
- Are there nested metadata blobs we should flatten? (example please)
- Expected traffic after alpha (RPS range) — helps sizing for Dedicated offer

Ad-hoc commands / snippets to keep handy:
- curl sample token exchange (sandbox):
  curl -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/token -d 'client_id=greenkey-sandbox&grant_type=client_credentials'

- quick jq example to convert timestamps:
  cat sample.jsonl | jq '.ingest_ts |= (. / 1000 | todateiso8601)'

Personal TODO (non-blocking):
- [ ] Write short email template for GK engineers with onboarding steps (I will draft and send Monday)
- [ ] Create a lightweight smoke test harness and commit to repo under `marketplace-integration/tests/greenkey`
- [ ] Capture cost estimate for 10k embeddings/day to propose Dedicated tier (ask finance for per-token cost)

Random thoughts (brain dump):
- Maybe we should include a small SDK wrapper for partners to flatten metadata — reduces schema churn
- Consider a temporary feature-flag to normalize timestamp formats for all marketplace partners

Next syncs:
- 03/13 10:00am quick check-in with infra (20m) -> unblock token roles
- 03/13 3:00pm internal demo of sandbox flow (invite: Liam, Aisha, infra-oncall)

End of scratchpad. Will tidy into a proper onboarding doc once most pieces are stable.
